definition: A purchased Major Arcana card. Pay 1 Reagent of its Element when it is drawn to add it to your Arcanum, or discard it. It persists across Ages and counts as a Harvest Source. Limit two, or three with the Hierophant.
One full round of play, made of Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter.
The player holding the Agekeeper's Key. They set the Cosmic Age, deal the Spring cards, manage the deck, and reset the board. The Key passes clockwise each Age.
The recipe printed on a Crucible Card, calling for an Attunement, Reagents, and Furnace Heat. Completing one Fires your Stone into the Forge.
The comparison of your Aspects against the Aspects of an Age. Alignment drives both the Harvest and the Siege.
Position 8 at the center of the Great Year Board. The first Stone to reach it wins the game.
The Tableau zone holding your Major Arcana cards, both Adepts and Fates.
The Sign, ruling Planet, and Element of an Age, or of any Harvest Source.

A token built on your Sign, crafted from 3 cards matching that Sign's ruling Planet. It is a Harvest Source, and it may fill one Attunement slot per Firing without being spent. It always stays on the Sign where it was built, though ownership can change hands through Trade.
A count of Element and Planet slots printed on a Crucible Card. Paid from Spread cards, which are spent, or from Astral Houses, which are not. Required alongside Reagents and Heat to Fire a Formula.
To discard a card in order to use the effect printed after the word.
The Spring rule freezing cards in their zones. From Card Lock until Winter, cards cannot move between your Hand and your Spread, though they may still be spent, crafted, traded, or committed.
A player-colored disc crafted from 3 cards of one suit, matching a Furnace's Element. Each Coal in a Furnace raises its owner's Heat by +1 in that Element.
The reference panel in front of each player on the Great Year Board. Shows the Coal and Reagent costs and the six Stellium effects.
The Sign set by the Agekeeper at the start of each Age, and the Aspects that follow from it.
A red-backed card bearing an Alchemical Formula. Each player holds four, dealt face up at setup.
The numeric value of a Minor Arcana card, from 1 for an Ace to 14 for a King. CV is scored in a Siege.
To spend 3 Essence of one Element and take the Reagent of that Element. Available on your turn in Summer, Autumn, and Winter.
A Summer contest of Zodiac Dice to steal a card from a rival's Spread. Highest roll wins, and the defender wins ties.
Fire, Earth, Air, or Water. Every Sign, suit, Furnace, Reagent, and Essence has one.
The base currency, paid out at the Harvest in the Element of the Cosmic Age. Three Essence of one Element Distill into one Reagent.
To remove one Coal from a Furnace. It returns to its owner's supply and their Heat in that Element drops by 1. A Ward can stop it.
A Major Arcana card that resolves the moment it is drawn. Some carry an effect lasting until Transit. Fates cost nothing, carry no Aspects, and are returned to the discard pile at Transit.
The Autumn action of completing an Alchemical Formula to send your Stone from the Mantle Ring into the Forge, beginning a Transmutation Stage.

The four stations a Stone occupies during a Transmutation Stage (positions 1, 3, 5, 7): Lead, Bronze, Silver, and Gold. There is one of each, shared by all players. A Stone in the Forge is exposed to Siege for one Summer.
One of four shared Elemental spaces, each holding three Coal. You may fuel only the Furnace matching your Sign's Element.
The 1 Essence every player takes in Spring, matching the Cosmic Age's Element.
The central objective: to be the first Alchemist to advance a Philosopher's Stone through all four Transmutation Stages to the Altar of Kismeta.
The full arc of a single game of Kismeta, one grand cosmic cycle. Each round of play is one Cosmic Age within it.
The private Tableau zone. Hand card effects are inactive and cannot be used in Crafting sets, but Hand cards may be committed in a Siege. Limit 5.
The Autumn payout of Essence, scored by comparing each of your Harvest Sources against the Aspects of the Cosmic Age.
Anything scored at the Harvest: your Zodiac Die, your Astral Houses, your Adept Cards, and your Spread Cards.
Your personal Heat level in an Element, raised +1 by each Coal you own in that Furnace: 1 is Kindled, 2 is Ablaze, and 3 is Radiant, the maximum. Formulas call for a level of Heat.
A blue-backed card, either Minor Arcana or Major Arcana.
The 22 special cards in the Kismeta Deck: 12 Adepts and 10 Fates. They are held in the Arcanum.
The track your Stone advances along, from START through four Transmutation Stages to the Altar of Kismeta. Its even positions (0, 2, 4, 6) are safe from Siege.
The 112 standard cards in the Kismeta Deck, 28 per suit. Each carries a Rank, a CV, a Suit, a Planet, and a printed Effect.
To cancel the Reversed effect of a card in your Spread. Both cards remain in play.
When a single source matches all three Aspects of the Cosmic Age at once, Sign, Planet, and Element, it scores the full stack. See Counting the Harvest.
Each player's primary game piece. It begins on START and must reach the Altar of Kismeta to win. It may be Resting, Forging, or in Stasis at any given time.

A refined token distilled from 3 Essence of one Element. Reagents pay Formulas, purchase Adepts, declare Sieges, Rekindle a Stone, and back a Fateful Wager. The four types are Sulfur, Vitriol, Quicksilver, and Aqua Regia.
The Autumn action of paying 2 Reagents to return a Seized Stone from Stasis to its previous Forge position.
An Adept's enhanced tier, active while the Cosmic Age shares one of its three Aspects. Use its Resonant text in place of Base while this holds.
A penalty that applies only while the card bearing it sits in your Spread. Moving it to your Hand, or Neutralizing it, ends the penalty.
To look at the top X cards of the Kismeta Deck, or at a rival's Hand, as the card states. What you learn is yours to keep.
The state of a Stone that lost a Siege. It moves to a nearby Stasis zone and must be Rekindled.
To switch off one card's printed text until Transit.

A Summer attack on a rival's Stone while it sits in the Forge, declared for 2 Reagents matching the Cosmic Age's Element and resolved by committing cards and comparing Alignment. Each Stone may be Sieged only once per Age.
The Sign rolled by the Agekeeper at the start of a Siege. All scoring in that contest is measured against its Aspects.
The Sign each player rolls on their Zodiac Die during a Siege, scored against the Siege Age. It never changes their Sign for the Age.
One of the twelve Zodiac Signs. Your Sign is set each Spring and holds for the Age.
The public Tableau zone. Spread card effects are active, they may be used in Crafting sets and Attunements, they score at the Harvest, and they can be lost in Duels. Limit 7.
Where a Seized Stone is held. It returns to the Forge by Rekindling. Marked with a ❄️ snowflake symbol.
A standing effect shown on your Codex panel. Hold three cards of one Planet in your Spread to activate it; it lasts only while all three remain. An Ace is wild for any one Stellium.
One of four categories on Minor Arcana cards: Wands, Cups, Pentacles, or Swords. Each corresponds to an Element, a Reagent, and a Furnace.
Everything you have in play: your Spread, Hand, and Arcanum.
The Autumn action of advancing a Stone that has spent a full Age in the Forge to the next Mantle Ring position, setting aside its Crucible Card and consuming the Coal it used.
Definition
A Summer action in which players freely exchange Adept Cards, Astral Houses, Essence, Kismeta Cards, and Reagents. Crucible Cards, Fate Cards, and Coal cannot be traded.
The final step of Winter. Duration effects end, Fate Cards are discarded, dice and Meeples are cleared, and the Agekeeper's Key and Cosmic Age Die pass to the next player.
One step along the Mantle Ring, begun by Firing the Stone and completed by Tempering it.
A protection printed on certain cards. The warded card, Stone, or resource cannot be targeted, as the card states.
Your personal 12-sided die. Roll it in Spring to set your Sign for the Age, in a Duel, and again in a Siege to set your Siege Sign.
The ring of twelve Signs on the Great Year Board, showing each Sign's ruling Planet, Element, and Harvest scoring values.
